name: ArgoCDAccount
description: Manage Argo CD local account tokens, and check what a token is permitted to do.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks/issues)

Prefer a project role token (**ArgoCDProject@1**) when one project is enough — its blast radius is smaller.
author: WayneGoosen

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Argo CD service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minting tokens needs a token with `update` permission on the project or account.

options.can-i: can-i - check whether this token may do something
options.get: get - read one account and its tokens
options.delete-token: delete-token - revoke a token by ID

inputs.name: account
inputs.label: Account
inputs.visibleRule: command = get || command = create-token || command = delete-token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Local account name. The account needs the `apiKey` capability in `argocd-cm` to hold tokens.

inputs.name: expiresIn
inputs.label: Expires in
inputs.helpMarkDown: Token lifetime: a number of seconds, or a number with a unit (`s`, `m`, `h`, `d`, `w`). **`0` means the token never expires.**

inputs.name: subresource
inputs.label: Subresource
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to check against, for example `payments/payments-api` or `payments/*`. Leave empty to ask about the resource as a whole.

inputs.name: failIfDenied
inputs.label: Fail if denied
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the answer is no. Useful as an early assertion that a pipeline holds the permissions it needs.

outputVariables.name: token
outputVariables.description: The minted token. Secret; only available immediately after creation.

outputVariables.name: tokenId
outputVariables.description: ID of the minted token, used to revoke it later.

outputVariables.name: tokenCount
outputVariables.description: Number of tokens remaining on the account.

outputVariables.name: tokenIds
outputVariables.description: Comma-separated token IDs on the account.

outputVariables.name: allowed
outputVariables.description: true or false, the answer to a can-i check.
